preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The length of each edge is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The starting vertex for the policeman is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The number of criminals is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
Each criminal's location is a distinct vertex from the starting vertex, s.

postconditions.description: The output is either the string 'Terrorists win' or an integer representing the time needed for the policeman to catch all criminals, where the time is the sum of the lengths of the edges traversed by the policeman.
